title: THE ANSWER LINE KEEPS THE NEWEST PRESS
why: Job 208: the answer line dropped a line whose text was said less than 0.35 s ago even when another line was said in between, so on, off, on left off on screen. The repeat guard now applies only when the same text came straight before.
now: Quick presses of a key that flips a state always leave the answer line on the state just set. A held key still does not repeat the line.

edits.anchor: var s=String(m), now=statusNow(), A=G.ans, seen=(G.ansSeen=G.ansSeen||{}), last=seen[s];
edits.replacement:
var s=String(m), now=statusNow(), A=G.ans, seen=(G.ansSeen=G.ansSeen||{}), last=seen[s], prev=G.ansPrev;   // v36.xx (cw-ansgap), job 208: prev is the text said just before this one
  G.ansPrev=s;

edits.anchor: if(last!==undefined&&now-last<ANSGAP) return A;                 // the key is still held: it does not come back
edits.replacement: if(last!==undefined&&now-last<ANSGAP&&prev===s) return A;      // the key is still held: it does not come back. v36.xx (cw-ansgap): only when nothing else was said in between, so on, off, on within 0.35 s leaves on
